name: bitagents
description: BITAGENTS hackathon MVP: AI agents powered by decentralized compute on Solana devnet.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c coral,cyan "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bitagents/shared && npm run build -w @bitagents/web && npm run build -w @bitagents/provider-worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bitagents/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bitagents/web && npm run typecheck -w @bitagents/provider-worker
